raw_text:
Disease: Alternaria_leaf_spot

Visible observations:
- Numerous distinct brown to purplish-brown spots distributed across the cotton leaf blade
- Some spots have lighter centers with darker borders
- Certain lesions coalesce into larger irregular necrotic patches, particularly on the right side of the leaf
- Multiple smaller lesions scattered throughout the leaf surface

Diagnostic evidence:
- Presence of numerous small circular brown spots with dark reddish-brown borders
- Coalescence of expanding lesions into larger necrotic patches
- Typical target-like or ringed lesion appearance on several spots

Reasoning:
The image clearly shows numerous circular to irregular brown spots with darker purple-brown borders spread across the leaf blade, with some lesions coalescing into larger necrotic patches. These visual characteristics align well with the symptoms of Alternaria leaf spot.
